name: paimon
description: Void AI 是一个本地优先的 AI 桌面工作台
author: Bess Croft

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build: pnpm run rebuild:native && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run rebuild:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run rebuild:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.test: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --test src/renderer/src/lib/i18n.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/settings.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/theme.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/errors.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/chat-messages.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/chat-persistence.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/chat-reconciliation.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/chat-tools.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/chat-media.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/agent-config.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/agent-drawer-model.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/pet-animation.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/generated-tool-ui.test.ts src/renderer/src/components/MessageList.test.ts src/renderer/src/components/MessageInput.test.tsx src/renderer/src/components/ReasoningSelector.test.ts src/renderer/src/components/AgentStatusWidget.test.ts src/renderer/src/components/MainPanelView.test.tsx src/renderer/src/components/ToolsPanel.test.tsx src/renderer/src/components/ui/controls.test.tsx src/renderer/src/components/ai-elements/rich-content.test.ts src/renderer/src/components/ai-elements/use-conversation-scroll.test.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.node.json --experimental-test-module-mocks --test src/main/server/index.test.ts src/main/lib/changelog.test.ts src/main/lib/chat-errors.test.ts src/main/lib/providers.test.ts src/main/lib/chat-tools.test.ts src/main/lib/web-page-reader.test.ts src/main/lib/media-generation.test.ts src/main/lib/agent-memory-files.test.ts src/main/lib/memory-orchestrator.test.ts src/main/lib/sandbox-agents.test.ts src/main/lib/runtime-architecture.test.ts src/main/lib/agent-coordinator.test.ts src/main/lib/agent-context-manager.test.ts src/main/lib/cron-store.test.ts src/main/lib/catalog-adapters.test.ts src/main/lib/mcp-so-adapter.test.ts src/main/lib/desktop-pet.test.ts src/main/lib/drizzle-metadata.test.ts src/main/lib/update-manager.test.ts && npm run test:agent-lifecycle
scripts.test:changelog: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --test src/renderer/src/lib/changelog.test.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.node.json --test src/main/lib/changelog.test.ts
scripts.test:agent-lifecycle: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const result = spawnSync(require('electron'), [require.resolve('tsx/cli'), '--tsconfig', 'tsconfig.node.json', '--experimental-test-module-mocks', '--test', 'src/main/lib/agent-completion.test.ts', 'src/main/lib/agent-tool-results.test.ts', 'src/main/lib/agent-lifecycle.test.ts', 'src/main/lib/agent-loop-session.test.ts', 'src/main/lib/run-tool-scheduler.test.ts', 'src/main/lib/agent-management-tools.test.ts', 'src/main/lib/conversation-workspace.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1' } }); if (result.error) throw result.error; process.exit(result.status ?? 1);}"
